title: Proton-GE
network: When enabled, checks GitHub hourly and downloads prebuilt releases. Installation waits until Proton games exit.
steamPending: Default and per-game selections will switch to Proton-GE Latest after Steam exits.
steamReady: Default and per-game selections use Proton-GE Latest.
restart: Restart Steam to load the updated Proton version.
status.deferred: Update queued until Proton games exit
status.rollback: Previous version restored; automatic updates paused
